steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: Haha... I will not lose to you... This incompetent human... I will surpass him as I have done before...

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: I've seen a darker reality. I understand everything about the unknown... I have Enfer's everything!
She screams hysterically and slashes at the Gate of Hell with invisible claws. With a mournful cry, massive energy spills out, and the obsidian withers and whitens into a fossil-like texture.
Sosia absorbs the energy, and the illusion of a man disappears.

steps.speaker: Black Illusion
steps.content: Fear... is reality...
After the storm subsides, she looks up at you.

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: Hehe... You shouldn't have pulled that trick on me... If you're so eager to die, I'll grant your wish...

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: My Witching Hour... You can't taint it...
Sosia fades backward into the twisted starry night, the air burns up, and the ground begins to crack. She has penetrated every corner of this space, dominating everything...

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Is it just me, or is she getting weaker?

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Just you. Sosia has absorbed Gate of Hell's energy and will definitely become stronger.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Shut the **** up! That little wimp is going to cry again!
Luckily, this is Witching Hour, and fear is the source of power. It would be real trouble if you had to face her head-on.
You think for a second, turn to your companions, and make a cheering gesture.

options: Just don't be afraid. You can do this!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She just made a big fool of herself in front of us. What is there to fear? She's just bluffing to save face.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you're still afraid, think of the way she was. She was so scared and started howling.
Someone can't help but laughs. You don't turn to look who it is. It's a good thing.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Understood. Labyrinth is not afraid. Labyrinth can protect Master, so Master doesn't need to be afraid.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: We just need EMP to step aside.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: There's no need to say that!! I have a reputation to keep, occasionally!!!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: It's not that easy to stop being afraid, okay? Otherwise, I wouldn't be a... well, coward all this time.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll give you courage.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Chief...!!!

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: ...Hmph, you're good at fooling people. Be grateful that it's the no-brainers that have come this time.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You look a lot more relaxed. Ready to fight?
She looks away and grunts.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Why are you looking at me? Ahem, I'm always ready!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Whenever you need.
Human minds are extraordinary. Because they're not sensible enough, they will be fearful of the unknown, eager to escape, and trapped in despair.
But for the same reason, even a glimmer of hope can ignite their instincts to struggle and to live. The shackles' power is recovering. It's still trying to grasp the bit of hope.
Anyway, the one who's alone and running away now, is not you.
